source_nodes.text: def html2text(html): """Strips tags from HTML text, returning markup-free text. Also, does a best effort replacement of entities like " " >>> r = html2text(u'Test &(\u0394ημώ)') >>> r == u'Test &(\u0394\u03b7\u03bc\u03ce)' True """ # based on answers to http://stackoverflow.com/questions/753052/ s = HTMLTextExtractor() s.feed(html) return s.get_text()
